integrity: Exact rooted-multiset proof, constructive intermediate-size realization and independently exhaustive small-carrier checker. Finite testing is not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Finite nonempty q-coloured structures with a chain of K nested equivalences, q>=1 and K>=1; no extra symbols; no priority certification of the coupled theorem. A 2012 bounded-height-tree textbook lemma was examined only in excerpt.
title: Sharp one-involution capacity for coloured nested equivalences
